_meta.description: Snapshot used by 2026_10_28_000000_fix_custom_artifacts_from_audit. Texts from CeciliaBot (+30 values), do not edit.

artifacts.name: Intoxicating Indulgence
artifacts.description: After using a non-attack skill, has a 100% chance each to grant swift attack and, for 2 turns, grant increased Speed to the ally with the highest Attack. Can only be activated once every 3 turns.

artifacts.name: Refracted Desire
artifacts.description: When the caster takes the first turn, has a 100% chance to grant increased Effectiveness to the caster for 3 turns. When an ally except for the caster takes the first turn, has a 100% chance to increase Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. Can only apply to one Hero within a team.

artifacts.name: Butterfly's Baptism
artifacts.description: Increase Evasion by 20%. At the start of an extra turn, increases Attack and Speed by 5% each, Can stack up to 3 times.

artifacts.name: Aubade Orb
artifacts.description: At the start of the first battle, acquires 10 Soul. At the end of the turn, has a 100% chance to acquire 5 Soul. Can only be activated three times.

artifacts.name: Excommunicant's Censer
artifacts.description: Increases Effect Resistance by 30%. At the end of an enemy's turn, when the caster does not have a debuff, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. Can only be activated once per turn.

artifacts.name: Glorious Flag
artifacts.description: Increases Evasion by 20%. After an ally uses a basic skill, has a 100% chance to increase Combat Readiness of the caster by 10%. This Artifact's effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.

artifacts.name: Unleashed Axe of Heavenly Mandate
artifacts.description: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 12%, and Hit Chance by 20%.
